SELECT sms10_alarm_history_id AS alarm_history_id , to_char(sms10_send_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS send_time_str
, f_emp_kor_nm(sms10_target_person_id) AS target_person_name
, f_emp_kor_nm(sms10_person_id) AS target_person_name
, sms10_content AS content , (sms10_send_yn = 'true') AS send_yn FROM sms10_alarm_history WHERE f_trunc(sms10_send_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_emp_kor_nm(sms10_target_person_id),sms10_content)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND sms10_person_id = #{personId}
AND sms10_target_person_id = #{personId} AND sms10_send_yn = 'true'
ORDER BY sms10_send_date DESC
